items.title: Event logs: waves, enemy-free periods, pickups, L1–L4 progression (48 missions + Endless)

evidence.detail: Bot pilot (not invulnerable) flew all 48 missions and 180 s of Endless on an exact export of 0c2fc79, observed by tests/review/event_log.gd. All 48 won; standard missions 10 waves in 89–97 s; enemy-free time median 16 s per mission (max 51 s, 1.01); L4 reached in 46/48. Bot never uses Bombs. One run per mission; numbers vary a little between runs.
